theorem parallel_transitivity (AB CD EF : Line) (h1 : ¬(AB.intersectsLine EF)) (h2 : ¬(CD.intersectsLine EF)) : ¬(AB.intersectsLine CD) := by
  -- We need to prove that AB and CD do not intersect.
  apply by_contradiction
  intro h
  -- Assume for contradiction that AB and CD intersect at some point.
  have h3 : EF.intersectsLine AB := by
    -- Since AB and EF are parallel, they do not intersect.
    apply h1
  have h4 : EF.intersectsLine CD := by
    -- Since CD and EF are parallel, they do not intersect.
    apply h2
  -- However, this leads to a contradiction because EF cannot intersect both AB and CD if they are parallel.
  <;> simp_all [Line.intersectsLine]
  -- This contradiction implies that our assumption is false, so AB and CD do not intersect.
  <;> tauto
